rows.note: Use 郵局 as the everyday all-purpose word for a post office location.

example.english: I'll go to the post office to mail a letter first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 jau4 guk2 gei3 fung1 seon3 sin1

rows.note: Use 郵政局 in official or formal contexts, or when referring to the postal organization rather than a particular branch.

example.english: The post office announced that registered-mail fees will be adjusted next month.
example.traditional: 郵政局宣布下月會調整掛號信收費。
example.jyutping: jau4 zing3 guk2 syun1 bou3 haa6 jyut6 wui5 tiu4 zing2 gwaa3 hou6 seon3 sau1 fai3
